name: free-llm-api-hub
description: A continuously-verified dataset of free-tier and trial-credit LLM API providers for developers.

scripts.test: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/check-release-stamp.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs

comment: devDependencies support JSON Schema validation, local social-image generation and reading PDF sources in the quote register (unpdf). The shipped site has zero runtime dependencies; CI installs the locked development dependencies with scripts disabled. badge-freshness.json is not committed (it is date-relative: the oldest age in days moves daily); the build writes it to site/ and every deploy publishes it — see docs/architecture.md. badge-verified.json IS a target (deterministic per dataset). `check` follows the regeneration mode (scripts/check-generated.mjs): in push mode it runs CI's push-mode gate, `regenerate-guard.mjs drift-gate`; in any other mode, or with `--strict`, the strict gate that verify.yml runs outside push mode. Both take the list of generated files from scripts/generated-targets.mjs (docs/regeneration-bot.md).
